_about: Videos a lesson's student task tells students to watch. Each entry is { "title": "…", "url": "https://…" }. tools/cas-ccps/build-lesson-assignments.js adds one line per video under the task's "Watch" line; new student docs and the Canvas cartridge make it a link, and previewVideoLinkRefresh() / applyVideoLinkRefresh() (Central Ledger, 53) add it to docs already made. An empty list is a lesson still waiting on its link (the generator lists them).
